audited_metrics.scoring_basis: Labels corrected during result audit after an independent prediction-blind policy review begun during the formal test; same first responses, no exclusions or reruns.

label_audit.type: independent prediction-blind policy review after formal test launch; labels corrected during result audit
label_audit.reviewer: separate code-review agent, explicitly did not read predictions
label_audit.scope: All 36 AUTO_RESEARCH, all 36 EXPERIMENT and all 16 public news_query cases (88 total), including correctly classified and failed cases.
label_audit.rule: ROUTER_PROMPT: when the topic is wholly absent and history cannot resolve it, return CHAT and ask for the needed topic.
label_audit.method: Correct gold labels only; retain every first response, API failure and all 210 test cases. No prompt/model change, exclusions or reruns. Original scores remain in the original run.

previous_limits: Project taxonomy adaptation, not official MASSIVE 60-way accuracy.
220 cases were authored and labeled by the implementation agent, not independent human blind annotation.
Case content was designed with the existing product policy available; no evaluation labels or rationales enter model requests.
Balanced test classes do not reflect production prevalence; source samples cover only CHAT and RESEARCH.
No claim of full workflow execution quality, out-of-domain detection or adversarial security.
label_audit.timing: Review began while the formal test was running, without reading predictions. Corrections were applied after first responses had been archived.
